s: Dine apiyya beyom tob ubo k"a seipim: muttar leepot bepureni, dehaynu tannur gadol upiv min hatztzad keen tannurim shellanu. Veap al pi shehu toreach tircha merubba yoter mishshehaya opeh betannur qatan sheppiv lemala, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu tzarik lekak, kegon sheyyesh lo okelin harbeh vetzarik leharbeh pat — en chosheshin letircha merubba. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bepureni yeshana, dehaynu sheapu bah kebar paam achat qodem yom tob, abal im hi chadasha sheadayin lo apu bah kelal — asur leepot bah paam harishona beyom tob, shemma tippachet mechamat godlah veyippased hallechem, veyimmana missimchat yom tob. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bepureni gedola, abal biqtanna muttar. Lepikak, yesh lehaqel betannurim shellanu sheenan gedolim meod, veod shettannurim shellanu en darkan lippachet leolam apillu keshehen chadashim.
Muttar lehachem chammin beantiki, dehaynu yora gedola, veen chosheshim lemarit haayin: shemma yomru bevadday letzorek chol hu mechammem harbeh kol kak.

Ap al pi sheetzim shennasheru min hailan beyom tob asur lehassiqan beyom tob kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"a, mikkol maqom, im napelu letok hattannur, o shehinnicham sham nokri shello middaat hayyisrael, im yesh battannur etzim acherim shel hetter, ap al pi sheatze haissur hem harbeh mehem — muttar lehosip ulehanniach od etzim shel hetter betok hattannur kede lebattel atze haissur berob atze hetter veachar kak massiqan, raq sheyyizzaher milligga baatze haissur qodem sheyyebattel berob. Veap al pi sheasur lebattel issur beyadayim, vegam hu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", shehare leachar yom tob hen muttarim belo bittul, vekol "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" apillu beelep eno batel, mikkol maqom, kevan sheissuran eno ella middibre soperim, vegam eno neheneh mehem ad achar shennisrepu, sheaz opeh et happat, veaz en haissur been — lekak heqellu chakamim lebattelan ap al pi shehu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin". Umikkol maqom, muttar lehanot mehen apillu bishat biuran, kegon lebashshel qedera kenegdan. Ap al pi sheadayin haissur hu been, mikkol maqom, kevan shebbishshul hattabshil eno iqqar hanaato, ella akilato hi iqqar hanaato, ubishat akilato eno neheneh ella mechom haesh shel issur shebbattabshil, vechom zeh shebbattabshil hu muprad umubdal kebar min gup haesh shel issur — hare eno neheneh kelal miggup haissur shehu been.

Veken muttar lehitchammem kenegdan ulehishtammesh leoran ap al pi shehu neheneh miggup haissur shehu been, lepi sheetzim shennitleshu beyom tob dinam kaatze muqtzeh, shemmuttar lehanot mehem hanaa habbaa meeleha, sheeno oseh maaseh begup hammuqtzeh bahanaato mimmenna, kemo shennitbaer besimman tq"t ayyen sham, veeno asur ella lehassiqan, sheoseh maaseh begup hammuqtzeh, veetzim hallalu shennapelu letok hattannur, kevan shebbeshaa sherotzeh lehassiq enan omedin lahanaat chimmum kenegdan ulehishtammesh leoran, shehanaa zo hi miggup haissur shehu been, ella kebar hen omedin lahanaat apiyya ubishshul, shehanaa zo hi leachar shehaissur eno been, lepikak hen betelim berob. Ap al pi sheakshav bishat hassaqa adayin haissur been, mikkol maqom, kevan sheiqqar hanaatan shellekak hen omedim ulekak hu massiqan enah baa lo ella ad leachar shehaissur eno been — lo hechemiru chakamim kol kak beissur muqtzeh sheen lo iqqar min hattora, vegam iqqar hanaato eno neheneh mimmennu beshaa shehaissur hu been.
Vekol zeh kesheatze haissur enan nikkarim tok atze hetter, abal im hem nikkarim — apillu beelep enan betelin.

Etzim shennitleshu min hailan beshabbat — asur lehassiq bahen beyom tob shelleacharayv, lepi shettelisha zo mekina otam lehassaqa, veen shabbat mekina leyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"g. Vaapillu bittul berob en moil lehattiran, lepi sheissur hakana mishshabbat leyom tob hu min hattora, velo heqellu be"dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" mechamat sheeno neheneh meissur shehu been ella bedabar sheissuro eno ella middibre soperim.
Asur liqqach etz mibben haetzim lachtot bo haesh battannur apillu hu yabesh verauy lehassiq bo beyom tob, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli beyom tob. Abal im hekino lekak meereb yom tob — muttar.

Otan hammassiqin beteben darkan laasot mehatteben qodem hassaqa chabilot chabilot qetannot, veogedim hachabilot umassiqin bahem, ukesherotzin lehassiq beteben beyom tob — tzerikim leegod hachabilot meereb yom tob, abal beyom tob asur leogdan, mippene shehu metaqqen keli beyom tob.

Tannurim shebbimehem hayu asuyim kiqdera upihen lemala, vehayu medabbeqin happat betok hattannur sebibot dopnotayv, vehaetzim vehaesh al shule hattannur, velo hayu tzerikim kelal ligrop et hattannur, veim napal letoko mittich hattit shebbedopnotayv, veyesh betiach zeh kede lecharek et happat, dehaynu shettiach hazzeh shennapal leshule hattannur hu gadol kol kak ad shennogea bappat haddabuq baddepanot umechorko — muttar legorpo min hattannur. Ap al pi shehu muqtzeh veasur betiltul, shehare eno rauy liklum beyom tob, mikkol maqom letzorek tiqqun "okel nepesh" hittiru letaltel muqtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"t ayyen sham. Abal im epshar leepot battannur beinyan shello yitcharek happat — asur legorpo, mippene shehu metaltelo shello letzorek "okel nepesh".

Veken im napal meereb yom tob veyada bo vehaya lo shahut letaqqeno o legorpo, veshakach o abar velo tiqqeno — asur legorpo beyom tob, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli, vahare zeh ke"makshire okel nepesh" shehaya epshar lo laasotan meereb yom tob sheasur laasotan beyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"t.

Abal muttar lehashkib haesh vehaeper hacham shebbeshule hattannur kede shello yiggeu bappat kelal, ap al pi shehu beinyan sheap im hayu nogein bo meat lo haya mitcharek, lepi shehaesh vehaeper hacham enan muqtzin kelal beyom tob, ayyen simman tatz"[ch].

Vekol zeh battannurim shellahem, abal tannurim shellanu shei epshar leepot bahem belo geripa — muttar legorpo mehaeper vehaggechalim apillu bemakbedet shettibbelah bemayim, veap al pi shehu mekabbeh, mikkol maqom, kevan shei epshar leepot belo kibbuy — hare kibbuy zeh tzorek "okel nepesh", umuttar kemo shemmuttar lehabir letzorek "okel nepesh". Abal im epshar leepot belo kibbuy, kegon shehattannur gadol vegarap miqtzat hattannur veepshar leepot beoto miqtzat — asur ligrop shear haggechalim shebbattannur apillu im hu choshesh shello yiggeu haggechalim bappat veyecharek miqtzato, lepi shebbigripa zo hu mekabbeh miqtzat haggechalim, apillu mekabbed otam bemakbedet shello tibbelah bemayim. Veap al pi shekkibbuy zeh yesh bo tzorek yom tob qetzat, shello yecharek miqtzat happat, mikkol maqom, kevan sheeno letzorek "okel nepesh", shehare epshar leepot belo geripa zo — asur laasoto beyom tob. Veen omerim: "mittok shehuttera melaka zo letzorek okel nepesh huttera apillu shello letzorek okel nepesh", kevan sheen hammelaka naaset begup ha"okel nepesh" atzmo, kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h.

Vaapillu im beoto miqtzat sheggarap nisharu bo gechalim daqqim sheen meakkebin et haapiyya verotzeh lekabbedan leyappot et happat — asur apillu lo tibbel hammakbedet bemayim, mippene shehu mekabbed shello letzorek "okel nepesh".

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen tzarik lehapig chom hattannur, abal im hussaq hattannur beyoter vechoshesh shello tissarep happat — muttar letabbel hammakbedet bemayim ulekabbed et (kol) hattannur apillu lo nisharu sham raq gechalim daqqim, veap al pi shehu mekabbeh, kevan shehu tzorek "okel nepesh" shello titqalqel happat — hare zeh muttar.

Abal achar shekkibbed hattannur — asur letabbel hammakbedet bemayim lekabbotah shello tissarep, shehare hu mekabbeh shello letzorek akila. Vaapillu im hu tzarik lah od, sherotzeh leepot od bo bayyom, mikkol maqom, kevan shekkebiyya zo enah ella "makshire okel nepesh", shehare en gupo neheneh mikkebiyya zo atzmah, lepikak im epshar lo lehashil makbedet acheret — asur lekabbotah ap al pi shettissarep kullah, ayyen simman tq"t.

Muttar leepot ulebashshel betannur vekirayim chadashim beyom tob ap al pi shello hussequ adayin meolam vehesseq rishon shellahem hu beyom tob, ubilbad shello yepigem betzonen achar hesseqan kede lechasseman (perush lehaqshotan ulechazzeqan), mippene shehu metaqqen keli beyom tob. Veim hussequ yoter midday vechoshesh shello tissarep happat verotzeh lahapigan betzonen — hare zeh muttar, lepi sheen derek lechasseman bemayim tzonenin, ella mannichin otan ad sheyyitztannenu mealehen, abal hatztzonenim peamim shemmeqalqelim otah, lepikak eno asur ella im ken mitkavven lechasseman al yede ken.
Abal en sakin otam beshemen lehachaliqan uletzachtzechan, veen shapin otam bematlit, mippene shehu metaqqen keli beyom tob.

Muttar leepot tannur male pat ap al pi sheeno tzarik beyom tob ella pat echad, mippene shehappat neepeh yapeh kesheyyesh pat harbeh betok hattannur, venimtza sheapiyyat kol happat hi tzorek yom tob. Abal im eno tzarik apillu pat echad beyom tob — asur lehaarim velomar: okal pat echad beyom tob, kede lehattir lo leepot pat harbeh, shello hittiru lehaarim ella keshekkol hammelaka naaset bebat achat, kegon sheopeh kikkar echad gadol meod kede sheyyotir mimmennu lechol, abal lo kesheopeh kikkarot harbeh veokel echad mehen beyom tob, kevan sheen derek lehannichah betok hattannur bebat achat ella bezeh achar zeh, vekol echad veechad hu melaka bipne atzmah. Lepikak, apillu im rotzeh leepot kullan bebat achat — lo chillequ chakamim ben apiyya laapiyya, veaseru lehaarim bekol inyan, ayyen simman tq"g.

Vekol zeh betannurim shellahem shehayu qetannim vehayu medabbeqim happat sebib dopnot hattannur, umittok sheyyesh bo pat harbeh en maqom lechummo lehitpashshet vehappat neepeh yapeh, abal betannurim shellanu shemmannichim happat al shule hattannur, apillu hu qatan meod — asur leepot bo yoter mimmah shetztzarik lo beyom tob. Veyesh sheen mechalleqin ben tannurim shellanu letannurim shellahem. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq, kegon mi shello hinniach erub tabshilin vetzarik lo pat leshabbat — muttar lo leepot beereb shabbat (qodem akilat shacharit, ayyen simman tq"g) letzorek hashshabbat im hu tzarik lepat echad bo bayyom atzmo.

Muttar listom pi hattannur betit hammugbal meereb yom tob, veap al pi shehu tach umemareach pi hattannur ubeshabbat haya chayyab mishshum lash, mikkol maqom beyom tob muttar, kevan shehu letzorek akila, sheal yede ken hattannur machaziq chummo vehattabshil mitztammeq yapeh. Abal asur legabbel hattit beyom tob, shehare epshar legabbelo meereb yom tob, vekol "makshire okel [nepesh"] sheepshar laasotan meereb yom tob — asur laasotan beyom tob min hattora. Vaapillu betit hammugbal mibbeod yom — en hetter ella im ken haya dato alayv meereb yom tob listom pi hattannur, sheaz en bo mishshum muqtzeh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Betit hattalush min haqqarqa, kegon hattit shebbarechob vekayyotze bo. Abal tit hammechubbar laqqarqa, kegon hattit sheal sepat hannahar, apillu zimmun bepeh en moil lo, ella tzarik lenatteqo meereb yom tob velaasot bo simman, veaz muttar littol mimmennu beyom tob.

Vekol zeh betit, abal eper muttar apillu legabbelo beyom tob velistom bo pi hattannur, lepi sheim yegabbelo meereb yom tob — yityabbesh velo yukal listom bo. Veyesh choleqin al zeh, veoserin legabbel apillu et haeper shei epshar legabbelo meereb yom tob. Veyesh lachush ledibrehem.
